feedback_text: Large reports keep timing out when our finance team exports more than six months of data.
Reporting is useful but exporting large datasets is extremely unreliable.
Our operations team splits annual reports into several smaller exports because large exports fail.
Prospect requires reliable large report exports before expanding usage to its finance organization.
Setting up the mobile app was frustrating because I had to keep switching between the app and email.
User could not complete mobile verification without opening the verification link on another device.
Mobile setup has too many verification steps and feels confusing.
Several users abandoned mobile onboarding while waiting for email verification.
Users are repeatedly logged out during long sessions and have to authenticate again.
Frequent session expiration interrupts our team's workflow.
The application takes too long to load when I first sign in.
Customer reports slow page loads when viewing accounts with large histories.
Enterprise prospect asked whether reports could be automatically delivered to executives every Monday.
Customer manually downloads and emails the same weekly report to twelve regional managers.
Scheduled report delivery would save our operations team several hours every month.
User says password reset emails sometimes take several minutes to arrive.
Finance manager described report preparation as one of the most repetitive parts of their monthly workflow.
Participant expected verification to happen entirely inside the mobile app.
Reporting has the data we need but getting it out of the product is painful.
The product works well once loaded but navigating between large customer records feels slow.
